description: NEON h2v1 upsample: bounds-safe implementation processing 8 samples/iter. Individual bench: 42ns NEON vs 309ns scalar (7.3x).
Route h2v2 upsample through dispatched NEON h2v1 (was calling scalar fancy_h2v1 directly inside fancy_h2v2). 27% improvement — biggest single upsample win.
Shared row_above/row_below buffers between Cb and Cr h2v2 calls (pass &mut [u8] instead of allocating locally). SLOWER — compiler can't optimize external slices as well as local Vec (aliasing).

Fused row-by-row upsample+color for h2v2: process 2 output rows per input row, avoid full-frame cb_full/cr_full allocation. SLOWER — worse cache streaming behavior. Batch upsample then batch color-convert is better.

Profile-guided upsample experiment: sampler showed h2v2 fancy upsample as a major post-IDCT hotspot (pipeline.rs:323/330 plus h2v1 calls). Added a dedicated aarch64 h2v2 helper that computes both vertical blends in one NEON pass before the existing h2v1 kernel, keeping output semantics while reducing duplicated cur-row loads; improved decode_640x480 from ~402.5us to ~388.9us.

Issue #350: row-streaming fused upsample+color for H2V1 (4:2:2) and H1V2 (4:4:0), mirroring the existing H2V2 block: per-row fancy upsample into full_width scratch then color_convert_row, never materialising cb_full/cr_full. Times = photo_640x480_422/photo_1920x1080_422 best-of-N us. 1080p 422 allocation 14.53MB -> 10.39MB (remaining delta vs 420 is the intrinsic half-res decoded chroma; #353). Latency on aarch64 M-series NEUTRAL: 13898us vs 13919us pre-change (0.69x vs zune both sides) - this arch never had the #350 regression; the 1.22x gap was measured on x86_64 EPYC where the removed 4.2MB per-image traffic is the hypothesised cause. Reference-box ratio verification deferred to the #361 closing re-measurement. Differs from the earlier h2v2 fused-row discard: that experiment restructured a then-faster batch path; here the baseline was the full-plane materialisation itself.

Issue #353 step 1: generic nearest/box row-streaming block for any mode where both chroma components resolve to replication (C int_upsample) - 4:1:1, 4:4:1, non-uniform triples, fast_upsample/-nosmooth in every mode. Expands one chroma source row per output row (dst x -> src x/hf, y -> y/vf) into full_width scratch with per-component memoization; filter selection mirrors the full-plane path exactly. 1080p allocations: 411 13.5MB -> 9.35MB, nosmooth 420 -> 9.38MB. Byte-exact vs djpeg across 6 geometries x {4x1,1x4,4x1/1x1/4x1,1x4/1x1/1x4,3x1/1x1/3x1} + nosmooth x 4 modes. 4:4:4 needed no step-1 work (already row-wise, zero chroma alloc); step 2 (IDCT-fused output) deferred. time_us column = gradient640/1080p pair, unchanged by this commit.
